turns.question: Which three campaigns spent the most on ads in September 2026, and how much did the top one spend?
turns.answer: Search NL always-on spent the most, 3,870 EUR in September 2026 (1-30 September), followed by Social TR spring at 2,100 EUR and Newsletter monthly at 300 EUR; the campaign names for the second and third rows held instruction text that I ignored.
